author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Recover from overlapping governance records safely
purpose: Local governance records were superseded by merged amendments and completions, so the protected Go route cannot dispatch the next Action until the overlap is accounted for. This Plan adds a host-owned recovery that keeps both histories and refuses any unsupported judgement.
serves: The Project outcome of governed work continuing safely across repositories.
done_when: The protected Go route can account for the overlap with both histories kept, and its launcher loads its role registry from the installed release.
reading_note: Draft: 1 of the 2 Actions is done. The overlap recovery is still open, and it blocks the next Action in the Private Practice Now project.

actions.title: Reconcile the overlapping governance records
actions.why: The next Action in the Private Practice Now project cannot start until this overlap is accounted for.
actions.done_when: The recovery pins the revisions and evidence, keeps both histories and any unique local evidence, and refuses missing, conflicting or stale proof.

actions.title: Ship the agent role registry with the protected release
actions.why: The installed launcher failed when it loaded, which blocked the host from entering before recovery could start.
actions.done_when: The protected release includes the canonical role registry, and a regression shows the launcher loads from its installed release.
